mode.title: Run mode
mode.description: Collect review records or generate a bounded observational report around an app release.

appIds.title: Android package IDs
appIds.description: One or more public Google Play Android package IDs.

language.title: Review language
language.description: Google Play language parameter used for page labels, dates, and localized review content.

languages.title: Release-impact languages
languages.description: Optional language list used by releaseImpact mode; the public Store page is requested for each language.

countries.title: Release-impact countries
countries.description: Optional country list used by releaseImpact mode; the public Store page is requested for each country.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Maximum reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Hard cap applied after parsing the server-rendered review sample.

sort.title: Review sort
sort.description: Requested public Store ordering. The current HTML path observes the page default; sort is recorded for diagnostics.

useBrowserFallback.title: Use browser fallback
useBrowserFallback.description: Reserved for the later browser-expansion phase. Phase 8 remains HTTP-only.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout seconds
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for each public Store request.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Emit the normalized input in debug logs for local troubleshooting; do not enable unnecessarily in production.

release.title: Release
release.description: Release metadata required by releaseImpact mode.

version.title: Version
version.description: Optional released app version used for report context.

releasedAt.title: Released at
releasedAt.description: ISO date-time used as the non-overlapping before/after boundary.

daysBefore.title: Days before release
daysBefore.description: Number of calendar days included before the release boundary in releaseImpact mode.

daysAfter.title: Days after release
daysAfter.description: Number of calendar days included after the release boundary in releaseImpact mode.

maxReviewsPerPeriod.title: Maximum reviews per release period
maxReviewsPerPeriod.description: Bound applied to each public Store request in releaseImpact mode.

analysis.title: Shared analysis
analysis.description: Run the shared deterministic analysis core. No external provider is configured in this phase.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Attach a shared-core analysis result to each review.

outputLanguage.title: Output language
outputLanguage.description: Use English summaries or preserve the original-language setting.

maxAttempts.title: Provider attempts
maxAttempts.description: Retry budget reserved for a future external provider.

aggregation.title: Clustering and reports
aggregation.description: Group actionable feedback per app, emit dataset summaries, and store one aggregate report per app.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Emit cluster and aggregate records and store per-app reports.

minimumClusterSize.title: Minimum cluster size
minimumClusterSize.description: Minimum number of similar actionable reviews required for a cluster.

comparison.title: Release comparison
comparison.description: Optional observational before/after comparison around a release timestamp.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Emit a before/after comparison report when a release timestamp is supplied.

releasedAt.title: Released at
releasedAt.description: ISO date-time used as the boundary between before and after windows.

daysBefore.title: Days before
daysBefore.description: Number of calendar days included before the release boundary.

daysAfter.title: Days after
daysAfter.description: Number of calendar days included after the release boundary.
